query:
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint
        FROM messages m
        JOIN threads t ON t.id = m.thread_id
        WHERE m.role = 'agent'
          AND m.msg_type IN ('message', 'summary')
          AND m.created_at >= $1
          AND (m.metadata->'context'->>'total_chars') IS NOT NULL
          AND ($2 = '' OR t.profile = $3)
